sourceText: Make the tool refuse false verification evidence instead of relying on the agent remembering rules. First, the two cheapest zero-schema fixes: reject an evidence row whose command and file fields contradict (F-049/F-050), and stop verification_evidence_refresh_stale from re-certifying a stale command-backed pass onto changed material (F-045/F-046/F-047).
normalizedOutcome: verification_evidence_add refuses a row whose command and file fields name contradictory targets; verification_evidence_refresh_stale leaves a command-backed result:pass row stale instead of silently re-certifying it, while still refreshing command-less attestation rows.
acceptanceClaim: Both false-evidence channels are mechanically closed: the two RED smokes (evidence-selfcheck, refresh-stale-honesty) go from failing to passing.
